gall_t1a.label: Incidental pT1a R0 gallbladder cancer after cholecystectomy: surveillance/observation pathway.

recommendation.title: Incidental pT1a R0 gallbladder cancer after cholecystectomy: surveillance/observation pathway.

options.label: Observation/surveillance
options.text: No additional oncologic hepatic resection when source criteria are satisfied; follow source surveillance.

gall_post_adv.label: Gallbladder cancer after surgery beyond pT1a and/or with adverse margin/nodal features: completion resection when appropriate and pathology-directed adjuvant therapy.

recommendation.title: Gallbladder cancer after surgery beyond pT1a and/or with adverse margin/nodal features: completion resection when appropriate and pathology-directed adjuvant therapy.

options.label: Completion/definitive resection
options.text: For appropriate residual-risk/resectable states.

options.label: Adjuvant therapy
options.text: Use capecitabine/chemoradiation or combination sequence only as source-defined by margin/nodes/resection status.

gall_primary.label: Resectable gallbladder cancer: hepatobiliary surgical staging/resection pathway; avoid non-oncologic biopsy when it would compromise surgery.

recommendation.title: Resectable gallbladder cancer: hepatobiliary surgical staging/resection pathway; avoid non-oncologic biopsy when it would compromise surgery.

options.label: Oncologic resection
options.text: Use hepatobiliary surgical principles and lymphadenectomy.

options.label: Selected neoadjuvant/clinical trial
options.text: Consider in source-defined situations.

gall_advanced.label: Unresectable/metastatic gallbladder cancer: biliary decompression/supportive care as needed plus systemic therapy and biomarker testing.

recommendation.title: Unresectable/metastatic gallbladder cancer: biliary decompression/supportive care as needed plus systemic therapy and biomarker testing.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use first-line biliary tract systemic therapy; subsequent targeted/immunotherapy by biomarkers.

options.label: Biliary drainage/palliation
options.text: Manage obstruction and symptoms.

intra_resect.label: Resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: multidisciplinary hepatic resection pathway followed by adjuvant planning.

recommendation.title: Resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: multidisciplinary hepatic resection pathway followed by adjuvant planning.

options.label: Resection
options.text: Curative-intent hepatic resection with appropriate nodal/pathologic assessment.

intra_unres.label: Unresectable/metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: systemic therapy + comprehensive molecular profiling; liver-directed therapy or transplant re-evaluation in selected source-defined cases.

recommendation.title: Unresectable/metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: systemic therapy + comprehensive molecular profiling; liver-directed therapy or transplant re-evaluation in selected source-defined cases.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use preferred first-line regimen and biomarker-directed subsequent therapy.

options.label: Liver-directed therapy
options.text: Consider arterial/ablative/RT approaches in selected liver-limited states.

options.label: Transplant re-evaluation
options.text: Only for source-defined eligibility states after response/stability.

intra_post.label: Post-resection intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: adjuvant therapy/surveillance by margin/nodal/pathology status; do not import gallbladder/extrahepatic-specific chemoradiation options unless source supports them.

recommendation.title: Post-resection intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: adjuvant therapy/surveillance by margin/nodal/pathology status; do not import gallbladder/extrahepatic-specific chemoradiation options unless source supports them.

options.label: Adjuvant systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-defined adjuvant option(s).

options.label: Chemoradiation
options.text: Only when INTRA-2 criteria support it; no cross-subtype leakage.

options.label: Surveillance
options.text: Cross-sectional imaging and clinically indicated labs.

extra_resect.label: Resectable extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: site-appropriate oncologic resection with lymphadenectomy and margin assessment.

recommendation.title: Resectable extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: site-appropriate oncologic resection with lymphadenectomy and margin assessment.

options.label: Definitive surgery
options.text: Hilar/distal site-appropriate resection per EXTRA-A.

extra_unres.label: Unresectable/metastatic extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: biliary decompression as needed, systemic therapy, biomarker testing, and RT/local palliation when indicated.

recommendation.title: Unresectable/metastatic extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: biliary decompression as needed, systemic therapy, biomarker testing, and RT/local palliation when indicated.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use biliary first-line regimen and biomarker-directed later-line options.

options.label: Drainage/local palliation
options.text: Manage obstruction and local symptoms.

extra_post.label: Post-resection extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: margin/nodal-directed adjuvant systemic therapy ± chemoradiation and surveillance.

recommendation.title: Post-resection extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma: margin/nodal-directed adjuvant systemic therapy ± chemoradiation and surveillance.

options.label: Adjuvant systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-defined adjuvant treatment.

options.label: Chemoradiation
options.text: May be included in source-defined margin/risk states.

options.label: Surveillance
options.text: Imaging every 3–6 months initially, then spacing per source.

phase_unknown.label: Biliary treatment phase is not established for this pathway.

outside_site.label: Primary biliary site is not established.

outside.label: Case is outside Biliary tract cancer ruleset.
